newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly up.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate closed slightly higher on Tuesday, but dealers said liquidity remained fairly loose in the banking system despite the central bank issuing NCDs on Monday to mop up excess funds.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 5.162 percent against Monday's 5.152 close, with 30-day commercial paper flat at 5.15-5.20 percent. Dealers expected the rates to hover around the current low levels in the near term.
The bond market was listless in the afternoon. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 6.0000 in early session. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
